grades: Entering 8th grade through the summer after high school
pay_detail: Tuition $775 plus a $100 registration fee credited to tuition. Optional housing with meals is $500 (2026 prices). Need-based aid and merit awards exist.
notes: Check the 2027 dates and prices before you plan.
name: Jacobs Summer Jazz Workshop
org: Jacobs Academy, Jacobs School of Music, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A week of jazz groups, theory, improvising, history and master classes. There is a student concert on the last Friday. All experience levels are welcome.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 18 on brass, woodwinds, voice, strings or rhythm instruments. No audition to get in, but you send a placement recording.
deadline_text: 2026 workshop ran June 7 to 13, 2026. Registration, placement recording and payment were due May 8, 2026. Financial aid deadline was April 13, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up online and pay the $100 fee and tuition. Then upload a placement recording that has not been edited. YouTube links are fine. Use the Jacobs audition portal.
